role: source-derived greedy EAGLE verification, accepted-length, and target-bonus semantics

authority: greedy target argmax verification against draft candidates
correct-draft count excludes the trailing target token
returned accepted length includes the trailing target bonus or correction token
draft extension receives accepted length including bonus
draft extension receives correct-draft count as accepted length minus one
next draft seed selects the last verifier-accepted position

limitations: The lock establishes source semantics for deterministic greedy chain acceptance only.
It does not establish stochastic rejection sampling, tree top-k greater than one, Apple performance, or Firewing correctness by itself.
